SIGNATURE LeBrunSalamon.PublishedInputs.BaseChangeFibers.generating_sections_unitOpen LEVELS [] TYPE ∀
  {Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{0}} {N : ℕ} (L : LeBrunSalamon.PhaseOne.LineBundle Y)
  (a : Fin (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} N 1) → LeBrunSalamon.PhaseThree.AlgebraicSection.{0} L.sheaf),
  LeBrunSalamon.Skeleton.TupleGenerates L a →
    ∃ U,
      Eq.{1} (iSup.{0, 1} U) Top.top.{0} ∧
        ∀ (i : Fin (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} N 1)) (T : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{0}) (f : Quiver.Hom.{0, 1} T Y),
          Set.range.{0, 1} ⇑f ⊆ ↑(U i) ↔
            CategoryTheory.IsIso.{0, 1} (LeBrunSalamon.PhaseTwentyEight.pullSection f (a i))
